text: Sinochem Holdings Co., Ltd is entry 43 in the directory of central state-owned enterprises (央企名录) published by SASAC, the State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission of the State Council, making the Chinese state its ultimate owner.
short: Sinochem Holdings is a Chinese central state-owned enterprise under SASAC.
